meta.description: Sunday digest of Colorado affordable housing news. One edition per week, Monday to Sunday, written from official releases and checked newsrooms. Each edition is a Markdown file in this folder.
meta.schedule: Sundays, about 6:40 am Mountain Time; published on the site when the weekly pull request merges

editions.title: Colorado Housing Week: Nov 2 – 8, 2026
summary: The southwest Colorado floods hit twice, and about 700 homes are damaged; the federal request still covers public infrastructure only.
Prop NN passed and Amendment 87 leads, which makes state housing money a little safer.
HUD opened an Express Lane for FHA construction loans on new LIHTC deals.
Polis's final budget request leaves a $1.6 billion gap; he presents it Nov 12.
The 30-year mortgage rate eased to 7.18%; 65% of metro Denver's October sales involved seller concessions.
